scholarships.name: European Union: Erasmus+ Mobility Programme for Higher Education Students
scholarships.description: Erasmus+ mobility of individuals sponsors study periods and traineeships (work placements) in 33 specified [Erasmus+ programme countries](https://eu.daad.de/infos-fuer-hochschulen/programmlinien/infos-zu-programm-und-partnerlaendern/de/45672-erasmus-programmlaender/) and in [Erasmus+ partner countries](https://eu.daad.de/infos-fuer-hochschulen/programmlinien/infos-zu-programm-und-partnerlaendern/de/45673-erasmus-partnerlaender/) around the world.
scholarships.deadlineText: Please contact the [International Office](https://eu.daad.de/service/ansprechpartner/erasmus-plus-hochschulkoordinatoren/de/46403-erasmus-hochschulkoordinatoren/) of your home institution for further information on the application deadlines.
scholarships.sourceQuote: The programme is intended for students who are regularly enrolled at a German higher education institution, have completed their first year of study (only applicable to Bachelor's students), are enrolled at a higher education institution participating in the Erasmus+ project AND whose home institution has signed an Erasmus cooperation agreement with the receiving institution.

eligibility.sourceQuote: For Bachelor's, Master's or doctoral students of up to 12 months

For students in comprehensive degree courses, such as medicine, programmes ending with a state examination or traditional diploma courses the grant will be awarded for a period of up to 24 months and an additional 12 months for students pursuing a doctoral degree.

applicability.sourceQuote: Erasmus+ mobility of individuals sponsors study periods and traineeships (work placements) in 33 specified [Erasmus+ programme countries](https://eu.daad.de/infos-fuer-hochschulen/programmlinien/infos-zu-programm-und-partnerlaendern/de/45672-erasmus-programmlaender/) and in [Erasmus+ partner countries](https://eu.daad.de/infos-fuer-hochschulen/programmlinien/infos-zu-programm-und-partnerlaendern/de/45673-erasmus-partnerlaender/) around the world.
